title: Vimshottari Dasha, Mahadasha, Antardasha, Pratyantardasha and current-period timing core

claims.RC-0105: The canonical 120-year Vimshottari cycle is calculated from the sidereal Moon birth Nakshatra using the fixed Ketu-Venus-Sun-Moon-Mars-Rahu-Jupiter-Saturn-Mercury sequence and 7/20/6/10/7/18/16/19/17 year weights.
claims.RC-0106: Mahadasha periods are materialized as explicit half-open JD(TT) ranges with the birth-Nakshatra elapsed fraction applied to the starting period balance.
claims.RC-0107: Each Mahadasha is partitioned into nine Antardashas beginning with the parent lord and using the canonical proportional 120-year rule.
claims.RC-0108: Pratyantardasha is supported as an optional third level using the same recursive proportional rule.
claims.RC-0109: At an explicit query JD(TT), exactly one running Mahadasha and Antardasha, plus optional Pratyantardasha, are resolved fail-closed.
claims.RC-0110: Every generated period exposes explicit start and end JD(TT) values with half-open boundary semantics.

non_claims: Rendered TR/EN Dasha timeline UI is not proven by this core gate.
Interpretation/editorial meaning for Dasha periods is not proven here.
Independent external golden/tolerance agreement across historical dates is still required before VERIFIED/DONE.
Device, entitlement, offline, PDF/backup and exact release readiness are not proven here.
